title: S&P 500 Earnings Expected to Rise 31% in Q3 as AI-Related Companies Lead Growth
source_used: Reuters story of 9 Oct 2026 (read via KFGO's copy) and the InvestorsHub rewrite on Yahoo Finance (11 Oct 2026)
key_facts: Analysts expect S&P 500 earnings to rise about 31% year over year in the third quarter, with the technology sector and AI heavyweights Alphabet, Amazon and Meta supplying two-thirds of the rise (Tajinder Dhillon, LSEG).
Second-quarter S&P 500 earnings grew nearly 54%, the highest since 2021 (about 35% excluding mark-to-market gains at Alphabet and Amazon on AI investments).
US semiconductor earnings are expected to be up about 136% in the third quarter against about 158% in the second.
Energy earnings are seen up about 115% after US oil prices rose about 30% in the quarter because of the US-Israeli war with Iran.
Ameriprise's Anthony Saglimbene: "approaching peak earnings growth"; Earnings Scout's Nick Raich: estimate revision momentum is starting to cool.
Earnings season starts unofficially the following week with banks including JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs; heavy borrowers such as utilities are at risk from higher interest rates.
quote_evidence: US companies are likely to deliver another earnings surge for the third quarter, and like the rally in the stock market, AI-related players are fueling most of those gains.
Year-over-year S&P 500 earnings grew in the second quarter by nearly 54%, the highest since 2021, LSEG data showed.
Earnings estimate revision momentum is starting to cool,
why_it_matters_hint: Most of the expected profit growth comes from AI-linked companies, so the market rally depends on AI spending continuing.
event_date: 9 Oct 2026 (Reuters); republished in rewritten form on Yahoo Finance 11 Oct 2026
notes: Older news re-dated: the Reuters original is dated 9 Oct 2026 (Caroline Valetkevitch); the Yahoo Finance page is InvestorsHub's rewrite of it, published 11 Oct 2026, so Yahoo is not the source. Not carried in the 9, 10 or 11 Oct editions.
